scope: Official route and GPX-version audit for ten records in the historic/original top-level event list 119–128; this is not the current event-dates.json insertion range 119–128.
rules: Old GPX files remain valid as historical/current fallback until an official replacement is downloaded, parsed and validated.
Never delete or overwrite older GPX files during this review.
Official Map/GPX panels and download buttons do not equal binary validation.
